limitations: Exactly three closed convex pieces of a planar rectangle; arbitrary disconnected covers and other piece counts not addressed.
No uniqueness classification of optimal partitions is claimed.
The 1958 unit-square endpoint is classical, not new.
The complete text of Heppes and Melissen (1997) was not accessible for direct priority assessment; its disk-cover problem is related but not logically equivalent.
title: A sharp three-piece diameter law for all rectangles
